title: Pork pie - Wiltshire
preamble:
Ingredients:-
12
oz Shortcrust pastry
2-3
oz cheddar cheese, diced
1/2
oz butter
2
tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
1
tablespoon chopped fresh sage
Salt
and pepper
1
onion, chopped
2
rashers streaky bacon
1
lb belly pork, chopped
1
small cooking apple, peeled and chopped
Pinch
of dry mustard
1
egg, beaten

rashers streaky bacon
1
lb belly pork, chopped
1
small cooking apple, peeled and chopped
Pinch
of dry mustard
1
egg, beaten

Method:-
Line a greased 9 inch pie plate
Fry onion and bacon in butter
Add pork and cook for 15-20 mins
Leave to cool, then stir in apple, cheese, herbs and seasoning
Add sufficient egg to bind mixture
Set oven to Gas Mark 7
Fill pie with mixture and add pie lid with steam hole
Brush with egg
Bake for 15 mins then reduce to Gas Mark 4 and bake for further 25-30 mins
